title: PR body never updated for the #63 rebase: the catalog-drift re-bless cause chain is documented only in commit 5c482df, not in the PR body
evidence: pr-body.md: "**Re-blessed (74 T2 frames, deliberately — the juice provably changes pixels everywhere: map grid 45%→18% blend, wire pipes→tier bands, primitive nodes→sprites, packets +35% with doorstep queues):**" — and grep of pr-body.md for 'rebas|#63|capacity_units|catalog|5.10' returns nothing (exit 1). Commit 5c482df message (read at the reviewed sha): "#63 changed a data catalog -> the catalog_hash shifted -> every T1 manifest + the affected T2 frames re-blessed on the rebased base (cause-documented; the 5.10 merge's own golden churn landed on pre-juice frames). The 15 conflicted PNGs resolve to MY juiced frames. ci-local 10/10, 32/32 demos, palcheck green."
detail: Job briefing acceptance item 3 requires "deliberate re-blesses documented" and item 4 requires "PR body carries: ... the re-bless list with before/after"; the r3 guard expected the #63 cause chain "documented in the PR body". The body attributes all 74 re-blesses solely to the juice and omits the rebase entirely.
recommended_fix: Add a rebase addendum to the PR body's Golden discipline section: #63's catalog change → catalog_hash shift → re-blesses regenerated on the merged tree (15 conflicts resolved to juiced frames), mirroring commit 5c482df's chain.
